title: High-Quality Single-Shot Capture of Facial Geometry
abstract: We introduce a novel, high-quality system for capturing the fine-scale detail of facial geometry in a single shot. The key idea of our system is to combine the benefits of active stereo illumination and dense pattern projection with recently introduced concepts for high-resolution geometry capture, while avoiding many common limitations. Possible applications include movie productions, face recognition, and digital character design for interactive environments.
summary: The paper "High-Quality Single-Shot Capture of Facial Geometry" presents a method for capturing detailed facial geometry using a single image. It combines active stereo illumination with dense pattern projection. The system claims to overcome many limitations in existing methods, making it suitable for applications such as movie production, face recognition, and digital character design. Upon review, there is currently no direct citation or application of this paper in further published research or industry usage that was identifiable. Consequently, its impact remains largely within the scope of theoretical advancements in facial geometry capture.
